articles.title: Peer-to-peer trading startup Variational raises $50 million for real-world perps in funding round led by Dragonfly
articles.snippet: The company is initially offering perpetual futures on real-world assets including oil, silver, copper and gold.

articles.title: Stablecoins retain the edge over tokenized money market funds, JPMorgan says
articles.snippet: The bank said tokenized money market funds account for only about 5% of the broader stablecoin universe despite offering yield.

articles.title: TradFi giant IG to expand crypto trading across Europe through Bitpanda
articles.snippet: The London-listed company is broadening its digital asset offering after introducing spot crypto trading for U.K. retail customers last year.

articles.title: Petition to scrap South Korea's crypto tax reaches 50K threshold
articles.snippet: Critics say the new 22% crypto tax, set to take effect in 2027, unfairly favors other asset classes with a much lower tax burden.

articles.title: OSL Strengthens Asia’s Digital Asset Ecosystem with Listing of State-Supervised Gold-Backed Stablecoin USDKG
articles.snippet: OSL Group (863.HK) (OSL), a global stablecoin payment and trading platform, today announced that its Hong Kong-licensed digital asset exchange OSL HK has officially listed USDKG, the gold-backed stablecoin issued by the Kyrgyz Republic.
